name: Who is responsible for creating and addressing punch list items?

mainEntity.name: Who is responsible for creating and addressing punch list items?

acceptedAnswer.text: The general contractor typically initiates the punch list, often in collaboration with the client and architect, if applicable. The general contractor then coordinates with relevant subcontractors to address each item. Maine Results, Inc. manages the entire process, assigning specific tasks to the appropriate trades and overseeing their completion to ensure every item is resolved satisfactorily before project sign-off.
acceptedAnswer.description: The general contractor usually initiates and manages the punch list process, coordinating with subcontractors to resolve items.
